evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — a speaker issuing a binding order to a recipient.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second imperative command to strip knowledge enacts the same authority-ranking directive pattern as src-1.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding command to eliminate or suppress knowledge, rather than requesting or negotiating it?
